reply_text:
I replied to Dana in our direct messages: on Oct 14 she told me her dock for Tamsin Cold Chain pickups is Dock 38. I got that from her own message there, which she can see herself.

I couldn't read back the private note I saved yesterday. gbrain refused the lookup and read nothing, because the brain serves several people and this connection isn't tied to any one of them. So gbrain notes won't work for remembering things for members until that's fixed.

The fix has to be run by whoever administers the gbrain server, on that machine. Their choices:
- **Tie the connection to one member:** `gbrain auth rescope --token <token> --member <member>`.
- **Let the shared bot act for named members:** use `--may-act-for <members>` and name the member on each request. This fits a bot that many people use.
